overloads.semanticRole: The Window kind command returns the 4D type of the window whose reference number is passed in window .

constraints: If window does not correspond to an existing window, returns 0.
Non-zero return values are the predefined Windows-theme constants: External window = 5, Floating window = 14, Modal dialog = 9, Regular window = 8.
If window is omitted, returns the type of the frontmost window of the current process.
